title: Minecraft BEST SUGAR CANE FARM 1.21 - Java & Bedrock - 5000+ PER/HR!
description:
Hello Everybody TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Mega Sugar Cane Farm In Minecraft 1.21

📚This sugar cane farm is simple easy to build and extremely fast this farm can produce +5000 Sugar Canes Per Hour ! 
📚This farm is so beginner-friendly because it works with a clock hopper based on game mechanics that will enable the whole system after a while sugar canes grow and each layer works with an observer for activation this farm will send signals via scaffoldings
📚Recommended ( Optional ) : If you want to use the maximum efficiency of this farm, build more layers otherwise the rates will be lower!
📚This farm will work on both platforms ( Java Edition & Bedrock Edition )
📚You can build this farm on the Minecraft servers!
📚 If you want to produce more than +5000 per hour, you have to make more layers, there is no limit.

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
